options.name: automatic_off
options.description: Automatically OFF Server Monitor, When KVM Launches.

options.name: client_type
options.description: Client Type. Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: keyboard_language
options.description: Select the Keyboard Language. AD is Auto Detect, DA is Danish, NL-BE is Dutch Belgium, NL-NL is Dutch Netherland. GB is English UK , US is English US, FI is Finnish, FR-BE is French Belgium, FR is French France. DE is German Germany, DE-CH is German Switzerland, IT is Italian, JP is Japanese. NO is Norwegian, PT is Portuguese, ES is Spanish, SV is Swedish, TR_F is Turkish F, TR_Q is Turkish Q.

options.name: media_attach
options.description: Two types of VM attach mode are available. Attach is Immediately attaches Virtual Media to the server upon bootup. Auto is Attaches Virtual Media to the server only when a virtual media session is started. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: non_secure
options.description: Enable/disable Non Secure Connection Type. Only the M6 model supports this parameter. Required when I(client_type=vnc).

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: retry_count
options.description: Number of times to be retried in case a KVM failure occurs.Retry count ranges from 1 to 20. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: retry_time_interval
options.description: The Identification for retry time interval configuration (5-30) seconds. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: ssh_vnc
options.description: Enable/disable VNC over SSH in BMC. Only the M6 model supports this parameter. Required when I(client_type=vnc).

options.name: stunnel_vnc
options.description: Enable/disable VNC over Stunnel in BMC. Only the M6 model supports this parameter. Required when I(client_type=vnc).

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
